newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hanwha Energy closes CDU for maintenance.
newsitem.headline: Hanwha Energy closes CDU for maintenance.

text.p: South Korea's Hanwha Energy Co Ltd said it had closed its No 2 crude distillation unit (CDU) over the weekend for annual maintenance.
Hanwha will restart the 200,000 barrels-per-day (bpd) unit on June 27, a company spokesman said on Wednesday.
The Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy had earlier said Hanwha had planned a maintenance shutdown between May 28 to June 21.
Hanwha, South Korea's smallest oil refiner in terms of capacity, has refining capability of 275,000 bpd. The nation's total oil refining capacity stands at 2.44 million bpd.
